content: anthropic_sdk_dart 7.0.0 (2026-08-01), same monorepo/maintainer as openai_dart, 160/160 points, ~21k downloads/30d. Pure Dart, SSE streaming with cancellation, AnthropicConfig baseUrl+timeout+RetryPolicy, client.messages.createStream yielding typed ContentBlockDeltaEvent/TextDelta. Covers extended thinking, tool calling, batches, and beta managed-agents surfaces. This means a direct-Dart Claude path is viable in 2026 for plain Messages API use; it does NOT reimplement the Claude Agent SDK's agent loop, and the shipped sidecar hosts claude-agent-sdk which itself shells out to the claude CLI. So sidecar removal is a capability trade, not a pure simplification.
